card.fires_on: The space or commas in the list of NS5A amino acid positions (28, 30, 31, 93) after 'polymorphisms at amino acid positions' in hepatitis C drug labels.

modes.label: Space before position numbers
modes.description: The space right after 'amino acid positions' and before the first number.

modes.label: Commas in the position list
modes.description: Commas separating the listed resistance positions 28, 30, 31 and 93.
